title: Ecology Succession, Food-Web, Migration & Population-Band Runtime
objective: Implement campaign-time ecological systemic response from accepted MNCS, World and Environment definitions using Packet-06 multi-resolution semantics: EcologySystemicProfileDefinition adapters, authored succession/food-web/migration/territory/resource-pressure transitions, exact/range/band/distribution/unknown population semantics, introduced/invasive-species hooks, extirpation/extinction/recovery/restocking/conservation transitions, and uncertainty-safe receipts/projections without creating a second creature/ecology simulator or inventing universal ecological equations.
acceptance: Ecology systemic profiles reference accepted MNCS/World/Environment owner facts and authored rule versions rather than copying canonical ecology, habitat or population state.
Population quantities preserve exact/range/band/distribution/unknown semantics and never fabricate exact individuals from aggregate state.
Authored carrying-capacity, habitat-suitability, succession, food-web, migration, territory and resource-pressure rules are applied only when present; missing rules remain explicitly unresolved.
Introduced/invasive-species, harvest/overhunting and resource-pressure hooks execute only from accepted authored interactions and never invent absent species relationships.
Extirpation, extinction, recovery, restocking and conservation transitions remain attributable to exact source Events, rules and owner versions.
Packet-06 aggregate/cohort/individual/adaptive-mixed semantics prevent double counting and preserve persistent individual identity during refinement.
Campaign time rather than wall-clock time drives offscreen ecological change.
Permission filtering precedes population counts, ecology search, diagnostics, explanation, AI context and export.
Ecology receipts/projections preserve uncertainty and owner authority, expose semantic/textual accessible equivalents and remain provider-off, optional-AI independent and paid-cloud independent.
boundaries: MSWI-01 and MSWI-03 plus all upstream completed programs remain sealed.
MNCS retains NPC/creature generation, ecology/habitat/lifecycle/population-generation and ecology authoring authority.
World/Environment owners retain canonical habitat, demographic and environmental state; MSWI-04 references accepted owner state and routes systemic transitions only.
Packet-06 owns shared multi-resolution aggregate/cohort/individual semantics; MSWI-04 must not invent a second resolution model.
No universal ecological equation, fabricated exact population, unnamed individual history or unsupported carrying-capacity/food-web interaction may be inferred.
MSWI-06 and later MSWI tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MSWI-04 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for the public MSWI-04 ecology profile/population/succession/migration/refinement seam, then implement only the bounded authored-rule, uncertainty-preserving, Campaign-time ecology behavior required by the reduced family contract.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started MSWI-04 from completed_verified MSWI-03.
